name: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
description:
About This Game

Imagine the frantic chaos of Geometry Wars combined with the addictive progression of Vampire Survivors. That’s Geometry Rift: an explosive bullet hell roguelite where thousands of geometric enemies swarm the screen and your sole mission is to survive.

Destroy endless hordes of enemies, unlock new weapons, create absurdly powerful builds and become a true machine of destruction. With frantic gameplay, satisfying combat and that irresistible ‘just one more game’ effect,

Geometry Rift is designed for players seeking pure arcade action.

## WORLDS AND CHALLENGES

Make your way through 4 unique worlds, each with its own enemies, final boss and visual style. Take on massive bosses inspired by arcade and science fiction classics. From tributes to the Martian invaders to gigantic geometric machines of destruction capable of filling the entire screen with projectiles.

What’s more, each world includes 3 special challenges that completely change the rules of the game in original ways.

WEAPONS AND POWER-UPS

Unlock new weapons and power-ups in every game to create increasingly devastating combinations. Lasers, massive bombs, chain lightning, shields, time freeze, black holes… Experiment, combine and break the game.

18 UNLOCKABLE SHIPS

Each ship has its own unique abilities and characteristics that change the way you play. Discover new strategies and find your favourites.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Would you rather focus on dodging while the auto-fire does the rest? Or would you prefer to aim manually using twin-stick controls? Geometry Rift lets you choose.

LOCAL CO-OP AND INFINITE MODE

Play on your own or with a friend in 2-player local co-op. Looking for a bigger challenge? Put your skills to the test in Endless Mode and compete for your place on the global leaderboard.

STORY AND MUSIC

Discover the story of the Rift through comic-style scenes scattered throughout the adventure. The entire soundtrack has been composed by Awesome, a legendary composer from the demoscene, and includes a visual player so you can enjoy the music outside of gameplay.

MUSIC BY AWESOME

  • All the music has been composed by Awesome, a legendary composer from the demoscene era. We have created a music player so that you can enjoy the music whilst watching demoscene effects.
